subject.title: site: add CrossModel to the provider grid

question: Should CrossModel be included in the landing page’s curated provider grid alongside OpenRouter and LiteLLM?
rationale: The code change is straightforward, but current source and documentation do not define objective inclusion criteria for the landing-page subset.

options.title: Include CrossModel
options.body: Merge the card because CrossModel is already a documented, registered API-key provider and the patch follows the established grid pattern.

options.title: Keep The Grid Curated
options.body: Decline the card if the landing page intentionally highlights only a smaller maintainer-selected set of providers.

options.title: Define Inclusion Rules
options.body: Pause this individual addition until the repository documents or automates which registered providers appear on the landing page.

recommendation.title: Include CrossModel
recommendation.body: Merge the card because CrossModel is already a documented, registered API-key provider and the patch follows the established grid pattern.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and recent website release history make @steipete the strongest available owner for this product-curation choice.
